rest_clearance_note: Computed against the original 7-link-only RESTING_ARM_LINKS check (right_shoulder_pitch/roll/yaw, right_elbow, right_wrist_roll/pitch/yaw). After extending that check to also include the gripper's own left_finger/right_finger/palm bodies (Phase 7D), this specific locked geometry was found to have a small, real, but operationally-inert collision: door_panel vs left_finger, up to -9.6mm, present ONLY when the arm is frozen at its idle/rest configuration while the door hinge is swept independently -- a scenario that never occurs in an actual run_trial_door_open trial, where the arm is under active IK-driven control from the first physics step onward. Documented and accepted rather than re-searched, given every real trial with this geometry (Phases 2-4, dozens of runs) succeeded with clean, correct physics throughout. See reports/phase7d-door-tests.md.
